page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top. Marginal notes in the right margin beside entries 12 to 22. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: 10. Regnorum bases & fundamenta, Religio, Justitia, & Prudentia.
12. Regia sedes in regni umbilico figenda.nervis:
13. Regnum ut floreat, divinitus ipsi dantur viri heroici.vigore:
14. Optimus regnorum status, minusq; mutationibus obnoxius, Monarchicus Aristocratia temperatus.temperatione:
Status Imperii Romani an sit Aristocraticus, an Monarchicus.
16. Nec regna ferre socium, nec tedae queunt.unitate:
17. Omnia regna suos habent limites fatales.Fatalibus
18. Fatales omnium regnorum & imperiorum sunt periodi.limitibus & periodis:
19. Circumactus regnorum periodis, Principum perit auctoritas, & mox sequuntur mutationes.
21. Ruina regnorum [illegible, ~10 letters], [illegible, ~8 letters], ὕβρεις, [illegible, ~12 letters] publicarum calamitatum.
22. Pestes omnium Rerumpublicarum, φιλοπ[?]ία, πολυ[?]μοσύνη, κακοζηλία, & Vindicta cupiditas.

page.notes: Greek words in entries 21 and 22 are only partly legible at this scan; the uncertain Greek is marked illegible rather than guessed. The marginal hyphen-glyphs after "vigore", "temperatione", "moderatione" and "unitate" are printed as a wrap mark and are shown as plain colons. Signature read as ")( 3". Entries 10 to 22 are numbered theses and are kept as paragraphs, not headings. Printed "Fatalibus" and "limitibus" notes are split across lines 17 and 18 as printed.
